prompt: Create a screener for the top 300 highly liquid stocks that identifies stocks whose first 5-minute candle each trading day crosses SMA20, SMA50, SMA200, and SuperTrend. A candle crosses each indicator when its low is strictly below and its high is strictly above that indicator; all four conditions must hold. Rank the liquidity universe independently for each scan date by positive total traded value (sum of close times volume) over the preceding 20 trading sessions, excluding the scan date and future data, with symbol ascending as the tie-breaker. Expose universe_size (default 300, range 1-300) and liquidity_lookback (default 20, range 1-90) as query parameters. Use the stored sma20, sma50, sma200, and superTrend columns. Show matches for multiple dates in one view, one row per stock per date, grouped by date. Use the last 10 trading sessions ending at the latest date with candles by default, with an inclusive from_date/to_date range filter for user selection and a maximum 90-calendar-day span. Evaluate each date independently in bounded queries and return only dates in the applied range. Calculate range as high minus low. Display a Ranked Table with columns in this order: stock as Symbol (text), scan_date as Date (date), high as High (price), low as Low (price), range as range (text), and date as Candle time (datetime). Sort dates newest first and sort each date by range descending by default; allow sorting overrides. Include symbol search, click-to-sort controls, and a date range filter. Show at most 1 stock per date, with Top N only pagination; total counts matches before per-date capping.
